question.text: A solution containing \(4 \mathrm{~g}\) of polymer in 4.0 litre solution at \(27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\) shows an osmotic pressure of \(3.0 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~atm}\). The molar mass of the polymer in \(\mathrm{g} / \mathrm{mol}\) is

solution.text:
Hint : \(\pi=i C(M) R T\)
\(3.0 \times 10^{-4}=1 \times C(M) \times 0.0821 \times 300\)
\(\therefore \mathrm{C}(\mathrm{M})=1.22 \times 10^{-5} \text {, Molarity }=\frac{\text { no. of moles }}{\text { vol. of solution }(\mathrm{L})}\)
\(1.22 \times 10^{-5}=\frac{4 / \mathrm{M}}{4}\). Hence \(M=81967 \approx 82000 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{mol}\)
